aiSummary: Significant unresolved financial concerns (Guideline F): $47,300 in delinquent debt across five accounts, with a new collection alert in June 2026. Foreign influence concerns (Guideline B): three family members resident in Nigeria, one employed by a state-owned enterprise, plus unreported April 2026 travel. SF-86 understated the delinquency, raising candor questions. Mitigation is partial at best; whole-person factors do not yet resolve the doubt.
